description: React component for editing scheduled posts in Mattermost, including handling of emoji, markdown, paste formatting, and modal interactions.

methods.name: saveDraft
methods.description: Saves the current draft message to storage, invoked on unmount or timeout.

methods.name: handleEdit
methods.description: Handles saving the edited post, including validation, hooks, and modal interactions.

methods.name: handleCancel
methods.description: Cancels editing and refocuses the original post or input.

methods.name: handleEditScheduledPost
methods.description: Handles updating a scheduled post, including validation, hooks, and modal interactions.

methods.name: handleEditKeyPress
methods.description: Handles key press events within the edit textbox, including hotkeys for markdown and submit.

methods.name: handleKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key down events for hotkeys like Ctrl+Enter, Escape, and markdown shortcuts.

methods.name: handleChange
methods.description: Updates the draft message state when the textbox content changes.

methods.name: handleHeightChange
methods.description: Adjusts scrollbar rendering based on textbox height.

methods.name: handleEmojiClick
methods.description: Inserts selected emoji into the message.

methods.name: handleGifClick
methods.description: Inserts selected GIF into the message.
